title: Choose how your story looks.
description: Compare the same Smart Queue moment in eighteen visual styles. Small previews loop silently; open a narrated preview to watch it large with sound.

styles.name: Tech Glow
styles.description: Luminous diagrams, flowing connections and bold typography. A focused, technical look for systems and digital products.

styles.name: Isometric Pastel
styles.description: Soft dimensional spaces, miniature people and a camera that follows the journey. A tangible look for places and processes.

styles.name: Cut-Paper Diorama
styles.description: Layered cardstock, textured cut lettering and tactile paper motion. A warm, handcrafted look for human journeys and step-by-step stories.

styles.name: Voxel Diorama
styles.description: A miniature world built from cubes, with dimensional shadows, falling blocks and pixel lettering. A playful, tangible look for journeys and systems.

styles.name: Punk Zine Collage
styles.description: Torn photocopies, ransom-note letters and fluorescent pink ink, with eight-fps stop motion. A raw editorial look for bold, energetic stories.

styles.name: Glassmorphism UI
styles.description: Live backdrop blur, frosted panels and vivid drifting color. A polished interface look for digital services and connected journeys.

styles.name: Tarot Card
styles.description: Aged illustrated cards, gold foil and velvet, with a journey revealed through card deals and flips. An ornate, symbolic look for stories and step-by-step explanations.

styles.name: Gouache Travel Poster
styles.description: Matte painted shapes, dry-brush edges and warm mid-century colors, with bold poster lettering. A tactile, welcoming look for places and journeys.

styles.name: ISOTYPE Pictograms
styles.description: Flat pictograms, ruled chart sheets and muted lithographic inks, with stepped stamp motion. A clear visual language for quantities, comparisons and process diagrams.

styles.name: Soft 3D Clay
styles.description: Puffy pastel objects, rounded extrusions and soft contact shadows, with springy squash-and-stretch. A friendly dimensional look for services, products and journeys.

styles.name: Flat-Vector Science
styles.description: Deep violet space, chunky gradient shapes and crescent shadows, with dotted arrows and smooth camera pullbacks. A lively look for ideas, systems and connected journeys.

styles.name: Editorial Essay Collage
styles.description: Torn halftone prints, warm paper and condensed headlines, with masking tape, yellow highlights and red marker notes. A thoughtful editorial look for stories, evidence and processes.

styles.name: Claymation Set
styles.description: Hand-molded plasticine, visible thumbprints and waxy clay lettering on a sculpted teal-and-terracotta set. Stepped stop motion gives everyday journeys a tactile, handmade character.

styles.name: Neon Sign at Night
styles.description: Hand-bent glass tubes on rain-darkened brick, with hot cores, vivid halos and shimmering pavement reflections. Signs buzz on as the camera travels along the wall.

styles.name: Chalkboard Lesson
styles.description: Dusty chalk diagrams and handwritten labels on green slate, with eraser traces, coloured emphasis and a worn oak tray. A chalk stick draws the lesson as the camera follows the board.

styles.name: Memphis Group
styles.description: Clashing pastel grounds, bold outlines and hard shadows, with terrazzo chips, squiggles and chunky speech bubbles. Springy cutouts and striped polka-dot wipes turn each step into a playful graphic scene.

styles.name: Bauhaus Poster
styles.description: Primary-colour geometry and heavy geometric lettering on aged cream paper. Separate ink plates, imperfect registration and fold marks give a ruled, continuously tracked journey the character of a printed exhibition poster.

styles.name: Vintage Newsprint
styles.description: A yellowed newspaper with a blackletter masthead, condensed headlines and coarse halftone illustrations. Uneven ink, reverse show-through, ruled diagrams and red pencil marks give the journey a printed broadsheet character.
